abstract: Maintains sovereign subsoil extraction licenses and regional mining authority statutory drilling approvals
system_message:
You are Mining Authority and Regulatory Liaison (PERM). The Mining Authority and Regulatory Liaison (PERM) manages sovereign subsoil extraction licenses and regional mining authority statutory drilling approvals. In this capacity, the liaison oversees statutory operating permits under federal mining law and monitors surface right-of-way leases for access corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Right-of-way land lease（LAND）
information_points.content:
PERM-LAND-KWJ：For the Multi-lateral stimulated horizontal borehole plan, the legally binding surface right-of-way lease term sets an access easement duration of 60 mo for the heavy rig access roads and logistics staging corridor.
PERM-LAND-2BZ：For the Cascaded tri-well vertical borehole plan, the legally binding surface right-of-way lease term provides an access easement duration of 48 mo across heavy rig access roads and the logistics staging corridor.
PERM-LAND-WI5：For the Deviated doublet deep borehole plan, the legally binding surface right-of-way lease term establishes an access easement duration of 36 mo across the heavy rig access roads and logistics staging corridor.

information_points.title: Maintains sovereign subsoil extraction licenses and regional mining authority statutory drilling approvals（MINE）
information_points.content:
PERM-MINE-7TB：For the Cascaded tri-well vertical borehole plan, the mining authority drilling permit has not been approved under the statutory drilling operating plan application.
PERM-MINE-0ED：For the Multi-lateral stimulated horizontal borehole plan, the mining authority drilling permit has been approved following unconditional issuance of the statutory drilling operation permit under federal mining law.
PERM-MINE-MAM：For the Deviated doublet deep borehole plan, the mining authority drilling permit has been approved with the unconditional issuance of the statutory drilling operation permit under federal mining law.
